calculation_handling.description: Minimum length of an accessible parking space is 5.6 m.
Minimum width of an accessible parking space is 3.9 m.
Minimum vertical clearance of an accessible parking space is 2.1 m.
Accessible spaces must be those closest to a main pedestrian access to the building.
calculation_handling.gaps: Parking layout and pedestrian access positions are not held.

units.disclosure: The requirement that accessible spaces be closest to a main pedestrian access is not evaluated; no parking layout is modelled.

calculation_handling.description: Accessible spaces must be on the same level as the pedestrian entrance.
calculation_handling.gaps: Parking layout and entrance levels are not held.

units.disclosure: The requirement that accessible spaces be on the same level as the pedestrian entrance is not evaluated; no parking layout is modelled.

calculation_handling.description: With 5 to 24 required parking spaces, at least 1 must meet the accessible dimensions.
calculation_handling.gaps: No dsl_target for the number of accessible spaces.

units.disclosure: The number of accessible spaces required by the 5-to-24-space band is not evaluated: no accessible-parking count target exists.

calculation_handling.description: With 25 to 100 required parking spaces, 1 for every 25 spaces or part thereof must meet the accessible dimensions.
calculation_handling.gaps: No dsl_target for the number of accessible spaces.

units.disclosure: The number of accessible spaces required by the 25-to-100-space band is not evaluated: no accessible-parking count target exists.

calculation_handling.description: Above 100 required parking spaces, 4 plus 1 for every 50 spaces or part thereof over 100 must meet the accessible dimensions.
calculation_handling.gaps: No dsl_target for the number of accessible spaces.

units.disclosure: The number of accessible spaces required above 100 parking spaces is not evaluated: no accessible-parking count target exists.

200.15.15.4(1).explanation: Under the transition rules an accessible parking space must be at least 5.6 metres long, 3.9 metres wide and have 2.1 metres of vertical clearance.

200.15.15.4(2).explanation: Accessible parking spaces must be the spaces closest to a main pedestrian access to the building and on the same level as the pedestrian entrance.

200.15.15.4(3).explanation: Where 5 or more parking spaces are required, accessible spaces meeting the dimensions must be provided: 1 for 5 to 24 spaces, 1 per 25 spaces or part thereof for 25 to 100, and 4 plus 1 per 50 spaces or part thereof above 100.
